# Original legacy model identity fixture

Two original synthetic glTF nodes, not third-party model data. Generated before
phase106 through FORGE's real model cooker, DirectModelImporter test adapter,
AssetImportService and AssetPublisher. The model is format4 / evidencev1.
The fixture generator binary SHA256 is `385cc66f7cb729f835cc1b16b7aded8ec5296df6ea225ddb63349b26d90de48d`.
Its exact recipe and input fingerprint are retained in the cooked manifest.

Only the source locator was renamed to Assets/Parts.glb after generation; catalog
and sidecar locators and their sidecar digest were updated together. Source bytes,
cooked bytes, member evidence, logical UUIDs, durable keys and artifact key are
unchanged. Keep this golden fixture frozen when the Gallery is reimported.
